svg.text: Where the errors are: error rate per column, all five core tables
Share of cells in each column that are errors (number of error cells in brackets). 193,986 cells in total, 18,414 errors.
Reading guide: a long bar means the column is a good place to look for errors; an empty bar means the column has no errors.
